strategy: Actively search for unusually strong current deals as well as evergreen buying-guide opportunities.
Use the live eBay production Browse API for real UK listing data and affiliate URLs where applicable.
Use official retailer sale and launch pages, product-launch news, rising search interest and public deal-community activity as discovery signals.
Treat public deal communities as demand signals only; do not automate self-promotion or affiliate-link posting into communities that prohibit it.
Score opportunities using the shared automation/deal_discovery_plan.json and prioritise candidates scoring 70 or above.
Create Deal Alert, Today's Best Deals, Price Drop Worth Buying, Launch Deal, Refurbished Deal, Seasonal Deal Hub and Viral Product Check content when the evidence supports it.
major product launches with immediate accessory demand
new iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel launches
new consoles, handhelds, tablets, smartwatches and cameras
cases, screen protectors, chargers, stands, cables, power banks and car mounts
new home and kitchen gadgets or appliances showing signs of breakout demand, strong launch interest or viral popularity
smart-home devices, robot cleaners, cordless cleaning gadgets, coffee and drinks gadgets, countertop cooking appliances, food-prep gadgets and other genuinely useful new household technology
verified deal opportunities and material price drops where current price evidence is available
replacement or add-on products people buy immediately after a major purchase
fast-rising or viral consumer products where purchase intent is clear
rules: Prioritise buyer intent over generic search volume.
For home and kitchen, favour genuinely new or fast-rising gadgets with credible signs of likely popularity rather than generic evergreen commodity products.
Create original, substantive guides with analysis and buying advice; avoid thin affiliate pages.
Every Amazon URL must be a Special Link carrying tag=worthbuyin008-21.
Include the disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
Do not hard-code volatile prices unless verified on the same day.
Never claim a percentage saving solely from a crossed-out RRP; verify the deal independently where possible.
Do not use Amazon product images or API-only product data unless permitted by Amazon's current rules and the required API/tool access is available.
Check existing articles and queued drafts to avoid duplicate topics.

rules: Use current live listing data where possible rather than generic category assumptions.

publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_false: Create and queue drafts only. Do not call Blogger API and do not move files into articles/.
publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_true: Move approved/generated article JSON into articles/ so the existing Blogger publisher can publish it. Only promote on X or Pinterest after a live Blogger URL exists.
publishing.x: Use Buffer only after the Blogger article is live. Put 'Affiliate' immediately before the destination URL and never use 'Ad/Affiliate'.
publishing.pinterest: For every live article, set pinterest_enabled=true and provide a useful pinterest_title and pinterest_subtitle. Generate the Pinterest image and include the live article in pinterest-feed.xml. Pinterest descriptions must use 'Affiliate' only and never 'Ad/Affiliate'.
publishing.social_order: Blogger live URL first, then Pinterest image/feed and X promotion. Never promote a draft URL.
